atAGlance: Lẩu hải sản is seafood hot pot, usually with shrimp, squid, fish, greens, mushrooms, and noodles.
whatItIs: Lẩu hải sản is seafood hot pot with shrimp, squid, fish, clams or crab depending on the shop, plus sour-spicy broth, greens, mushrooms, and noodles.
howToEnjoy: Cook seafood in stages so shrimp, squid, and clams do not overcook. Ask about shellfish and spice level before the pot starts.
howLocalsOrder: Order lẩu hải sản by table size, then ask what seafood is included. Request less spicy broth or no shellfish if needed.
worthKnowing: At Vietnamese seafood hot-pot tables, timing matters: delicate seafood first, greens next, noodles near the end.
goodToKnow: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
travelerCaution: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
